title: get api health returns server status and timestamp
description: Test the GET /api/health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status with a JSON body containing status 'ok', a message string, and a valid ISO 8601 timestamp when the server is running normally.

title: post api auth login with valid credentials returns token and user
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint with valid username and password to ensure it returns a 200 status with a JWT token and user object containing id, username, fullName, and role.

title: post api auth login rate limits excessive attempts
description: Test the POST /api/auth/login endpoint by sending more than 10 login attempts within 15 seconds from the same IP to verify it returns a 429 Too many login attempts response.

title: post api auth change password with valid current and strong new password
description: Test the POST /api/auth/change-password endpoint with a valid JWT token, correct current password, and a new password that meets the strength policy (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number) to verify it returns 200 with a success message.

title: post api users create new user with valid data as admin
description: Test the POST /api/users endpoint with admin authorization and valid user data to create a new user, expecting a 201 response with the created user object.

title: post api items import preview with valid csv file
description: Test the POST /api/items/import/preview endpoint with a valid CSV file upload to verify it returns 200 with normalized rows and any validation errors without writing to the database.

title: post api transactions receipts create single receipt transaction
description: Test the POST /api/transactions/receipts endpoint with valid data to create a single receipt transaction, verifying it returns 201 with the transaction object and lastPaidPrice, and that the item's lastPurchaseCost is updated.

title: post api transactions transfers create atomic transfer pair
description: Test the POST /api/transactions/transfers endpoint with valid data and sufficient stock to create an atomic transfer pair (outbound and inbound transactions), expecting a 201 response with transfer details.

title: get api transactions stock position returns paginated inventory
description: Test the GET /api/transactions/stock-position endpoint with valid authorization to verify it returns 200 with paginated aggregated inventory positions including item details, quantities per location, average cost, and total value.

title: post api production kit executes kitting order with stock validation
description: Test the POST /api/production/kit endpoint with valid data including finishedGoodId, location, quantityProduced, and components or bomId, ensuring it validates stock availability, calculates cost rollup, creates production order and related transactions, and returns 201 with order details.
